headline: PROP sector leads the market with multiple large price gains and high‑volume spikes, while FOOD stocks show mixed moves.
market_take: Prop stocks dominated today, with KC (+0.03, +50.00% volume) and UV (+1.1, +22.22% volume) among the top movers and SAMCO posting a 17.5σ volume spike and +8.05% intraday rise. Food names were split, highlighted by AQUA's +11.11% intraday jump on a 4.9σ volume surge versus F&D's -11.48% decline. Cons and PF&REIT saw notable volume anomalies, especially STI (14.7σ) and TLHPF (8.0σ). Recent filings were largely governance‑related, with no immediate price‑impact alerts.
